in_sanskrit.name: Kavinraj
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of treasure, wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kavinraj एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kavi means 'Lord of Knowledge, Poet' and Raj means 'King, Ruler'. Thus, Kavinraj signifies the one who rules over knowledge and treasures.

in_hindi.name: Kavinraj
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of treasure, wealth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Kavinraj एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Kavi means 'Lord of Knowledge, Poet' and Raj means 'King, Ruler'. Thus, Kavinraj signifies the one who rules over knowledge and treasures.

in_telugu.name: Kavinraj
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of treasure, wealth
in_telugu.long_meaning: Kavinraj ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Kavi means 'Lord of Knowledge, Poet' and Raj means 'King, Ruler'. Thus, Kavinraj signifies the one who rules over knowledge and treasures.

in_marathi.name: Kavinraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of treasure, wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kavinraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kavi means 'Lord of Knowledge, Poet' and Raj means 'King, Ruler'. Thus, Kavinraj signifies the one who rules over knowledge and treasures.

in_bengali.name: Kavinraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of treasure, wealth
